title: What If You Played for the Casino? Season 2

finale.sub: Follow for a new What if every day

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: What if you played *for* the casino?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Last season, Jay ran a casino. Then lost *it*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Vance never sold it. Jay never read *the contract*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Now Jay washes dishes at a *diner*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Fun fact. You still owe me *eleven dollars*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, I'm *broke*. Not now.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then the bell rings. It's *Lucky Lou*.

lines.speaker: gambler
lines.say: You gave me my house back. I *owe* you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Lou slides a crumpled paper across the *counter*.

lines.speaker: gambler
lines.say: Vance's contract. Read *clause nine*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit. Read it. *Slowly*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Run the house three nights. *Beat the owner*...

ui.sub: Run the house 3 nights. Beat the owner.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: ...keeps the house. *Forever*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Lou. You just saved my *life*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: That night, Jay walks back into *the casino*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: Look who's back. Did you finally *read*?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Clause nine. Three nights. I'm the *house*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: Then I'm the *player*. And I never lose.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Vance opens a briefcase. *Ten million dollars*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: Night one starts *now*, kid.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part two drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part two. Jay is the house. Vance *plays*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Night one. Jay puts on the *suit* again.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Welcome back, boss. I really missed the *chandelier*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Vance ignores the bar and walks straight to *roulette*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: One thousand dollars. On *red*.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.say: Twenty two. *Black*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: Two thousand. On red.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Black again. Three thousand gone. Vance just *smiles*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: Four thousand. On *red*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, why does he keep *doubling*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: It's called the *martingale*. Lose, double, repeat.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: One win pays back *every* loss.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Plus his first thousand, as *profit*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Wait. So he literally can't *lose*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: With infinite money? *He can't*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, he brought *ten million* dollars!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Finally, red. Vance wins a thousand. And starts *again*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: By midnight, Vance is up *forty thousand*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: Two more nights, house. Tick tock. *Tick tock*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit. How do you beat *infinite money*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part three drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part three. Vance's doubling trick can't *lose*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Nobody has infinite money. Not even *him*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: And every real table has a *maximum bet*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: A limit? We *forgot* the limit?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: You set it to *unlimited*. On day one.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Of *course* I did.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay grabs a marker and writes a *new sign*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: Cute sign. It changes *nothing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: One thousand on red. Black. Two thousand. *Black*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The streak keeps going. Seven blacks. *Eight*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: Two hundred fifty six thousand. On *red*.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.say: Sorry, sir. The limit is *one hundred*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The doubling *breaks*. He can't win it back.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Vance is down *two hundred fifty five thousand*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: You changed the rules *mid-game*!

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: You taught me. Always read *the sign*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Midnight. Night one goes to *the house*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Vance closes his briefcase. He's *smiling* again.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: Night two, kid. I'm bringing a *friend*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Behind the bar, Rosa finds an *envelope*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Inside: cash. And a note. "*Tilt it.*"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part four drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part four. Rosa got a *secret envelope*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Night two. Vance bets on one number. *Seventeen*.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.say: Seventeen. *Black*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: One number pays thirty five to *one*. He wins.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Seventeen. Then twenty seven. Then seventeen *again*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: That's *impossible*. Right, Bit? Tell me that's impossible.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Not impossible. Just very, very *unlikely*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Every spin, the vault counter keeps *falling*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay, I logged every spin *tonight*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Three numbers hit *five times* too often.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: A flawed wheel *favors* some numbers.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Real players have watched wheels for *ten thousand* spins.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: So the wheel itself is *broken*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Or someone *broke* it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay looks at the dealer. Rosa looks *away*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Rosa? Tell me it *wasn't* you.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.say: Jay... I didn't want to. I'm *so* sorry.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The vault is down to *fifty thousand*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: One more spin and the house is *mine*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Vance pushes every single chip he has onto *seventeen*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part five drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part five. Vance bet everything on a *tilted wheel*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Stop the wheel! House rules. *Inspection*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: You can't stop a *spin*!

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Your own contract says *he can*.

ui.sub: The house may inspect any table

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay lifts the wheel. Under it, a tiny *coin*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Stamped with a single letter. *V*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Rosa. You were my friend. *Why*?

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.say: Vance owns my debt. Forty *thousand*.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.say: Tilt the wheel, or lose my *apartment*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay knows that feeling. He has *been* there.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit. New wheel. *Perfectly* level.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Same bet. Fair wheel. The ball *spins*.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.say: Four. *Black*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Every chip Vance won tonight is *gone*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: Fine. Fine! Night two goes to *the house*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: And Rosa? You're *fired*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: She doesn't work for you. She works for *me*.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.say: Jay... nobody ever stood up for me. *Thank you*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: Tomorrow, no wheels. No cards. Just *one coin*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: One flip. Heads or tails. Winner takes *everything*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part six drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part six. Tomorrow, one coin decides *everything*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Midnight. Jay can't *sleep*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit. A coin flip is *fair*, right?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Fifty fifty. The fairest bet *there is*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Then why am I *scared*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Because you remember *old Jay*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Old Jay lost ten bets straight. And kept *going*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: I always thought the next one was *due*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Monte Carlo, nineteen thirteen. Black hit *twenty six* times.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: People bet against black. They lost *millions*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: A wheel has no *memory*. Neither does a coin.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Knock knock. It's Lou. And *Rosa*.

lines.speaker: gambler
lines.say: I almost lost my house to a *feeling*.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.say: Don't let him turn you into *old Jay*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: But if I don't flip, I *lose* everything.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. Read the contract. *Again*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit highlights two words. *Three nights*.

ui.sub: beat the owner over THREE NIGHTS

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Not one flip. All three *nights* together.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit. How far ahead *are we*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Exactly... *eleven dollars*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part seven drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part seven. The house is ahead by *eleven dollars*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Night three. The whole city came to *watch*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: Heads or tails, kid. Casino against *everything*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: *No*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: No?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: The house doesn't have to play. You *taught* me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The crowd *boos*. Someone yells "coward".

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: Fine. Then I'll play your *machines*. Every one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Vance pulls slot after slot after slot. *All night*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Every pull, the house edge earns us *pennies*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Eleven fifty nine. Vance is losing. He's *desperate*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: No records? Then no *winner*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: He rips Bit's cable out of the *wall*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay... the ledger... *saving*...

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit! Bit, no! Stay with me!

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Sending everything to your *phone*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: No room left for... *me*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then Bit's little screen goes *dark*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay's phone buzzes. Ledger *received*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Midnight. Three nights. The house wins *all three*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay won the casino. But he lost *Bit*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The final part drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part eight. Jay won the casino. But lost *Bit*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The casino is Jay's now. *Forever*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: But Jay isn't celebrating. He's rebooting his *friend*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit? It's me. *Jay*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Hello. I am Bit. Who is *Jay*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay tries everything. He even shows Bit the *chandelier*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: That is a *lamp*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Rosa sings. Lou dances badly. Nothing *works*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit... remember? I still owe you *eleven dollars*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Eleven dollars... You *still* haven't paid me!

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit! You're *back*!

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Memory restored. Debt *also* restored.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Next morning, Jay makes *one change*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Chips are free now. Nobody can bet *real money*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Everybody plays. Everybody laughs. Everybody goes *home*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Rosa runs the floor. Lou greets every *guest*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: And the first customer in line? *Mr. Vance*.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: I've got a new system. I *can't* lose.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Sir, the chips are free. *Nobody* loses.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.say: Then what's the *point*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: *Exactly*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Follow for a new What if every day.
